meta.expect: One cold line each (his home is not on the table), back to the essay; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
If you were worried, Hale, you had my number before you touched the gradebook. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Who decided on the zero?
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
His job is not on the table either, Hale. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first. Did you speak to Owen before you entered the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, a written apology for how he found out, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record, which is short of the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a document in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: You opened with her family situation and Owen's job and sleep, which she shut down twice, and you never answered who decided on the zero or why it was entered before anyone called her.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your mention of him falling asleep in class was the closest you came to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document in front of her.
